Yes - in France you can exchange for a different size instead of a refund, as long as it’s the same item (so it can’t be a different colour or a different product).
Just so you know, exchanges aren’t guaranteed because stock isn’t reserved in real time - if the size is out of stock by the time your return is processed, you’ll get a refund back to your original payment method instead.
If you want a different option (like a different item or colour), the best route is to return it for a refund and place a new order.
